title: OORI announces a strategic partnership with Oumla to advance digital investment infrastructure for banks and financial institutions
summary: Partnership brings enterprise-grade technology to OORI OS, enabling institutions to deliver more transparent, secure, and efficient private market investment experiences

contentHtml:
OORI, the Saudi-based investment platform focused on private markets, announced today a strategic partnership with Oumla, a Saudi-based digital assets infrastructure provider. Image courtesy: OORI

Partnership brings enterprise-grade technology to OORI OS, enabling institutions to deliver more transparent, secure, and efficient private market investment experiences

Press Release

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia – OORI, the Saudi-based investment platform focused on private markets, announced today a strategic partnership with Oumla, a Saudi-based digital assets infrastructure provider, to advance the digital investment capabilities available to banks and financial institutions. 

The partnership combines OORI’s private markets expertise and its B2B technology platform, OORI OS, with Oumla’s innovative technology solutions. OORI OS streamlines and digitizes the entire private-market investment lifecycle, bringing together opportunity discovery, due diligence, Shariah screening, investment structuring, investor onboarding, portfolio management, and reporting in one platform. Powered by AI agents and advanced analytics, it simplifies operations and supports better investment decisions.

Oumla’s infrastructure layer will enable financial institutions to fully digitize their operations, automate complex workflows, and reduce administrative overhead which will strengthen the core infrastructure of private market investing. Enhanced ownership recordkeeping and transaction traceability deliver complete visibility, while accelerated processing ensures a seamless experience across every stage of the investment lifecycle.

OORI and Oumla are both backed by Avalanche, ADGM-regulated digital assets foundation which provides technical and infrastructure support. This shared infrastructure will support closer collaboration as the partnership develops and help both companies reach institutions across a wider ecosystem.

Naif Alajmi, Co-Founder, Board Member and Head of Arranging at OORI, said: “With Saudi private investment fund assets reaching SAR 700 billion in Q1 2026, up 26.1% year on year, the demand is clear. What has been missing is infrastructure that makes serving it cost-effective. Oumla’s technology and OORI’s OORI OS platform allows us to bring private market opportunities to eligible investors at a fraction of the traditional cost, through a modern and scalable solution for modern investors ”

Mohammed Aljasser, Chief Executive Officer of Oumla, said: “Digital assets only matter if they change who can access an investment and what it costs to get there. OORI is proving that in Saudi private markets. Our infrastructure handles the asset digitization and on chain record keeping behind it, built to the security standards institutions expect, so OORI can focus on its investors.”

The partnership reflects a growing priority among financial institutions to modernize how investment products are distributed, administered, and monitored, in a manner that is secure, transparent, and aligned with regulatory expectations. By embedding advanced technology within a platform institutions already rely on, OORI and Oumla aim to make that modernization practical and scalable.

About OORI

OORI is a platform licensed by the Saudi Capital Markets Authority (CMA) under license No. (26341-30), operating as a private markets platform focused on technology and alternative assets. It is on a mission to expand access to private market opportunities through regulated, technology-enabled infrastructure —solving for access, affordability, and liquidity. The company is building for the future of private markets, with a long-term vision that includes smart contracts and more efficient digital investment rails built on its own Layer 1 chain on Avalanche. OORI’s name — meaning “to show” or “to guide” in Arabic — captures its purpose: to make the previously invisible, visible. 

Website: https://oori.co/  

Media Contact: oori@digitaldigest.me

About Oumla

Oumla is a Saudi digital asset infrastructure company, founded in 2022 and based in Riyadh. It is on a mission to help institutions adopt digital assets safely, through tokenization, custody, and blockchain connectivity hosted in the Kingdom and certified to SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001. The company works with banks, corporates, and government entities to bring real financial assets on-chain, and executed the first Islamic repo on blockchain, settled in Saudi riyals with Sukuk as collateral, recognized by the International Capital Market Association (ICMA).

Website: https://oumla.com/
